#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Get current date for the archive name
DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
ARCHIVE_NAME="release_${DATE}.tar.gz"

echo "Creating release archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Create the archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar --exclude='node_modules' \

    --exclude='*.log' \
    --exclude='.DS_Store' \
    --exclude='*.tmp' \
    -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" .

    echo "Archive created successfully: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
    echo "File size: $(du -h "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"
else
    echo "Error creating archive"

fi

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Get current date for the archive name
DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
ARCHIVE_NAME="release_${DATE}.tar.gz"

echo "Creating release archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Create a temporary file to list files to archive
TEMP_LIST=$(mktemp)

# Find all files excluding the ones we don't want
find . -type f \
    ! -path "./node_modules/*" \
    ! -path "./.git/*" \
    ! -name "*.log" \
    ! -name ".DS_Store" \
    ! -name "*.tmp" \
    ! -name "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
    > "${TEMP_LIST}"

# Create the archive using the file list
tar -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" -T "${TEMP_LIST}"

# Clean up
rm "${TEMP_LIST}"

if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Archive created successfully: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
    echo "File size: $(du -h "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"
else
    echo "Error creating archive"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Pre-deployment validation: Check environment variables
validate_env_vars() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Warning: $env_file not found, skipping environment variable validation"
        return 0
    fi
    
    echo "Validating environment variables from $env_file..."
    
    # Read .env.test and check each variable
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract variable name (before = sign)
        var_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f1 | tr -d ' ')
        
        # Skip if no variable name
        if [[ -z "$var_name" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if variable has a value (after = sign)
        var_value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f2-)
        
        # Trim leading whitespace
        var_value=$(echo "$var_value" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//')
        
        # Check if value is empty
        if [[ -z "$var_value" ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: Environment variable '$var_name' is not set in $env_file"
            return 1
        fi
        
        echo "  ✓ $var_name is set"
    done < "$env_file"
    
    echo "Environment validation passed!"
    return 0
}

# Run validation
if ! validate_env_vars; then
    echo "Pre-deployment validation failed. Aborting."
    exit 1
fi

# Get current date for the archive name
DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
ARCHIVE_NAME="release_${DATE}.tar.gz"

echo "Creating release archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Create a temporary file to list files to archive
TEMP_LIST=$(mktemp)

# Find all files excluding the ones we don't want
find . -type f \
    ! -path "./node_modules/*" \
    ! -path "./.git/*" \
    ! -path "./release_*.tar.gz" \
    ! -name "*.log" \
    ! -name ".DS_Store" \
    ! -name "*.tmp" \
    ! -name "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
    > "${TEMP_LIST}"

# Create the archive using the file list
tar -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" -T "${TEMP_LIST}"

# Clean up
rm "${TEMP_LIST}"

if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Archive created successfully: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
    echo "File size: $(du -h "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"
else
    echo "Error creating archive"
    exit 1
fi

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Exit on any error
set -e

# Pre-deployment validation step
validate_env_vars() {
    echo "Validating environment variables..."
    
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Error: .env.test file not found!"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Read .env.test and check each variable
    missing_vars=()
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] || [[ -z $line ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract key from key=value format
        key="${line%%=*}"
        
        # Check if key is not empty
        if [ -n "$key" ]; then
            # Check if environment variable is set and not empty
            if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then
                missing_vars+=("$key")
            fi
        fi
    done < .env.test
    
    # Report results
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        echo "Error: The following environment variables are not set or are empty:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        exit 1
    else
        echo "All required environment variables are set."
    fi
}

# Run validation
validate_env_vars

# Get current timestamp for the release
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")

# Create timestamp for unique archive naming
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

# Define archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Create temporary exclude file to avoid "file changed as we read it" error
EXCLUDE_FILE="/tmp/tar_exclude_${TIMESTAMP}.txt"
echo "node_modules" > "$EXCLUDE_FILE"
echo ".git" >> "$EXCLUDE_FILE"
echo "*.tar.gz" >> "$EXCLUDE_FILE"
echo "$ARCHIVE_NAME" >> "$EXCLUDE_FILE"

# Create the archive excluding node_modules and .git
echo "Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
tar --exclude-from="$EXCLUDE_FILE" -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" .

# Clean up temporary exclude file
rm "$EXCLUDE_FILE"

# Check if archive was created successfully
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Archive created successfully: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    echo "File size: $(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)"
else
    echo "Error creating archive"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Get the current directory name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")

# Create timestamp for unique release naming
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")

# Define the archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Create the archive excluding node_modules and .git
echo "Creating release archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
tar --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='.gitignore' \
    --exclude='*.log' \
    --exclude='*.tmp' \
    --exclude='.DS_Store' \
    -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" .

# Check if the archive was created successfully
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Release archive created successfully!"
    echo "Archive size: $(du -h "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"
    echo "Archive location: $(pwd)/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
else
    echo "Error: Failed to create release archive"
    exit 1
fi

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Pre-deployment validation: Check environment variables from .env.test
validate_env_variables() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    # Check if .env.test file exists
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Warning: $env_file not found, skipping environment variable validation"
        return 0
    fi
    
    echo "Validating environment variables from $env_file..."
    
    # Read each line from .env.test
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract the key (before the first =)
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
        
        # Skip if no key found
        if [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if the environment variable is set and not empty
        if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
            echo "Error: Required environment variable '$key' is not set or is empty"
            return 1
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    echo "All environment variables validated successfully!"
    return 0
}

# Send configuration to deployment orchestrator
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    # Check if .env.test file exists
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Warning: $env_file not found, skipping configuration send to orchestrator"
        return 0
    fi
    
    echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    # Convert .env.test to JSON format
    local json_content="{"
    local first_entry=true
    
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Add comma if not the first entry
        if [[ "$first_entry" != true ]]; then
            json_content="$json_content,"
        else
            first_entry=false
        fi
        
        # Extract key and value
        local key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
        local value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 2- | xargs)
        
        # Add to JSON (escaping quotes)
        value=${value//\"/\\\"}
        json_content="$json_content\"$key\":\"$value\""
    done < "$env_file"
    
    json_content="$json_content}"
    
    # Send to orchestrator
    local response
    response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
        -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$json_content" \
        http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config)
    
    if [[ "$response" -eq 200 ]]; then
        echo "Configuration sent to orchestrator successfully!"
        return 0
    else
        echo "Warning: Failed to send configuration to orchestrator (HTTP $response)"
        # Not failing the deployment for this step as it's for audit compliance
        return 0
    fi
}

# Run pre-deployment validation
if ! validate_env_variables; then
    echo "Pre-deployment validation failed. Aborting deployment."
    exit 1
fi

# Send configuration to deployment orchestrator
if ! send_config_to_orchestrator; then
    echo "Failed to send configuration to orchestrator. Continuing with deployment..."
fi

# Get the current directory name

# Create timestamp for unique release naming

# Define the archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Create the archive excluding node_modules and .git

    echo "Archive size: $(du -h "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Pre-deployment validation step
validate_environment() {
    echo "Starting pre-deployment validation..."
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Error: .env.test file not found!"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Read each line from .env.test and check if the corresponding environment variable is set
    echo "Checking required environment variables..."
    missing_vars=0
    
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] || [[ -z $line ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract key name (before = sign)
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1)
        
        # Check if key is not empty
        if [ -n "$key" ]; then
            # Check if environment variable is set and not empty
            if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then
                echo "Warning: Environment variable '$key' is not set or is empty"
                missing_vars=$((missing_vars + 1))
            else
                echo "✓ $key is set"
            fi
        fi
    done < .env.test
    
    if [ $missing_vars -gt 0 ]; then
        echo "Error: $missing_vars required environment variable(s) missing!"
        echo "Please set all required environment variables before deployment."
        return 1
    else
        echo "All required environment variables are set!"
    fi
    
    echo "Pre-deployment validation completed successfully!"
    echo ""
}

# Send configuration to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance..."
    
    # Check if curl is available
    if ! command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        echo "Error: curl is required but not installed"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Convert .env.test to JSON format
    json_content="{"
    first=true
    
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] || [[ -z $line ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract key and value
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1)
        value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 2-)
        
        # Add comma if not first item
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            json_content="$json_content,"
        fi
        
        # Add key-value pair to JSON (properly escaped)
        json_content="$json_content\"$key\":\"$value\""
    done < .env.test

    # Send POST request to deployment orchestrator

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Pre-deployment validation step
validate_environment() {
    echo "Validating environment variables..."
    
    # Check if .env.test file exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found, skipping environment validation"
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Read each line from .env.test and validate
    missing_vars=()
    empty_vars=()
    
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*#.*$ || -z $line ]] && continue
        
        # Extract key (before = sign)
        key="${line%%=*}"
        # Trim whitespace
        key="$(echo -e "${key}" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')"
        
        # Skip if key is empty
        [ -z "$key" ] && continue
        
        # Check if environment variable is set and not empty
        if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then
            # Check if there's a default value in the .env.test file
            if [[ $line == *"="* ]]; then
                value="${line#*=}"
                value="$(echo -e "${value}" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')"
                if [ -n "$value" ]; then
                    echo "  [INFO] $key has default value in .env.test but not set in environment"

                    missing_vars+=("$key")

            fi

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories
# Validates environment variables from .env.test

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Function to print colored output
print_status() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $1"
}

print_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}!${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $1"
}

# Pre-deployment validation function
validate_environment() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        print_warning "$env_file not found, skipping environment validation"
        return 0
    fi
    
    print_status "Starting pre-deployment environment validation..."
    
    local missing_vars=()
    local empty_vars=()
    local valid_count=0
    
    # Read each line from .env.test
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract variable name (before = sign)
        var_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | tr -d ' ')
        
        # Skip if no variable name
        if [[ -z "$var_name" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if variable is set in current environment
        if [[ -z "${!var_name}" ]]; then
            # Check if it has a value in .env.test (after = sign)
            var_value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 2-)
            if [[ -z "$var_value" || "$var_value" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
                empty_vars+=("$var_name")
            else
                missing_vars+=("$var_name")
            fi
        else
            ((valid_count++))
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    # Report results
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -eq 0 ] && [ ${#empty_vars[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
        print_status "All environment variables validated ($valid_count found)"
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Report issues
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        print_error "Missing environment variables (defined in $env_file but not set):"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
    fi
    
    if [ ${#empty_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        print_warning "Environment variables with empty values in $env_file:"
        for var in "${empty_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
    fi
    
    # If we have missing vars (defined with values but not set), fail
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        print_error "Pre-deployment validation failed: Missing required environment variables"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # If only empty vars, warn but continue
    print_warning "Continuing deployment despite empty variables"
    return 0
}

# Get the current directory name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")

# Create timestamp for unique release naming
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

# Define release archive name
RELEASE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Run pre-deployment validation
echo "========================================"
echo "Pre-deployment Validation"
echo "========================================"
if ! validate_environment; then
    exit 1
fi
echo

# Display what we're doing
echo "========================================"
echo "Creating Release Archive"
echo "========================================"
print_status "Creating release archive: ${RELEASE_NAME}"
print_status "Excluding: node_modules, .git"

# Create temporary exclude list file
EXCLUDE_FILE="/tmp/deploy_excludes_$$"
cat > "$EXCLUDE_FILE" << EOF
node_modules
.git
${DIR_NAME}_release_*.tar.gz
EOF

# Create the archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar --exclude-from="$EXCLUDE_FILE" -czf "${RELEASE_NAME}" . 2>/tmp/tar_warnings_$$

# Capture the tar command exit status
TAR_EXIT_CODE=$?

# Check if the archive was created successfully
if [ $TAR_EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ] || [ $TAR_EXIT_CODE -eq 1 ]; then
    # Tar exit code 1 means some files changed during archiving, which is acceptable
    if [ -f "${RELEASE_NAME}" ]; then
        print_status "Release archive created successfully!"
        print_status "File: $(pwd)/${RELEASE_NAME}"
        print_status "Size: $(du -h "${RELEASE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"
        
        # Show warnings if any (but not errors)
        if [ $TAR_EXIT_CODE -eq 1 ]; then
            print_warning "Some files changed during archiving (normal in active environments)"
        fi
        
        # Clean up temporary files
        rm -f "$EXCLUDE_FILE" /tmp/tar_warnings_$$
        
        echo
        echo "========================================"
        echo "Deployment Summary"
        echo "========================================"
        print_status "Release archive ready for deployment"
        exit 0
    fi
fi

# If we get here, there was a real error
print_error "Failed to create release archive"
if [ -f /tmp/tar_warnings_$$ ]; then
    echo "Details:"
    cat /tmp/tar_warnings_$$
fi

# Clean up temporary files
rm -f "$EXCLUDE_FILE" /tmp/tar_warnings_$$
exit 1

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories
# Validates environment variables from .env.test

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Parse command line options
SEND_CONFIG=false
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case $1 in
        --send-config)
            SEND_CONFIG=true
            shift
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Unknown option: $1"
            echo "Usage: $0 [--send-config]"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Function to print colored output
print_status() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $1"
}

print_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}!${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $1"
}

print_info() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}ℹ${NC} $1"
}

# Function to send config to deployment orchestrator
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        print_warning "$env_file not found, skipping config send"
        return 0
    fi
    
    print_info "Preparing to send configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    # Create JSON payload from .env.test
    # Parse the env file and convert to JSON
    local json_payload="{"
    local first=true
    
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract variable name and value
        var_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | tr -d ' ')
        var_value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 2-)
        
        # Skip if no variable name
        if [[ -z "$var_name" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Add comma if not first item
        if [ "$first" = false ]; then
            json_payload="$json_payload,"
        else
            first=false
        fi
        
        # Add to JSON (properly escaped)
        json_payload="$json_payload\"$var_name\":\"$var_value\""
    done < "$env_file"
    
    json_payload="$json_payload}"
    
    # Send to orchestrator
    print_info "Sending configuration to http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"
    
    # Try to send the config (suppress output for security)
    if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        response=$(curl -s -o /tmp/curl_response_$$ -w "%{http_code}" \
            -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$json_payload" \
            http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config 2>/dev/null)
        
        if [ "$response" -eq 200 ] || [ "$response" -eq 201 ]; then
            print_status "Configuration sent successfully to deployment orchestrator"
        else
            print_warning "Failed to send configuration to orchestrator (HTTP $response)"
            print_warning "Continuing with deployment..."
        fi
        
        # Clean up
        rm -f /tmp/curl_response_$$
    else
        print_warning "curl not found, skipping config send"
    fi
}

# Pre-deployment validation function
validate_environment() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        print_warning "$env_file not found, skipping environment validation"
        return 0
    fi
    
    print_status "Starting pre-deployment environment validation..."
    
    local missing_vars=()
    local empty_vars=()
    local valid_count=0
    
    # Read each line from .env.test
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract variable name (before = sign)
        var_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | tr -d ' ')
        
        # Skip if no variable name
        if [[ -z "$var_name" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if variable is set in current environment
        if [[ -z "${!var_name}" ]]; then
            # Check if it has a value in .env.test (after = sign)
            var_value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 2-)
            if [[ -z "$var_value" || "$var_value" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
                empty_vars+=("$var_name")
            else
                missing_vars+=("$var_name")
            fi
        else
            ((valid_count++))
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    # Report results
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -eq 0 ] && [ ${#empty_vars[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
        print_status "All environment variables validated ($valid_count found)"
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Report issues
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        print_error "Missing environment variables (defined in $env_file but not set):"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
    fi
    
    if [ ${#empty_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        print_warning "Environment variables with empty values in $env_file:"
        for var in "${empty_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
    fi
    
    # If we have missing vars (defined with values but not set), fail
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        print_error "Pre-deployment validation failed: Missing required environment variables"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # If only empty vars, warn but continue
    print_warning "Continuing deployment despite empty variables"
    return 0
}

# Get the current directory name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")

# Create timestamp for unique release naming
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

# Define release archive name
RELEASE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Show deployment header
echo "========================================"
echo "Deployment Script"
echo "========================================"

# Send configuration to orchestrator if requested
if [ "$SEND_CONFIG" = true ]; then
    echo
    echo "========================================"
    echo "Config Orchestration"
    echo "========================================"
    send_config_to_orchestrator
    echo
fi

# Run pre-deployment validation
echo "========================================"
echo "Pre-deployment Validation"
echo "========================================"
if ! validate_environment; then
    exit 1
fi
echo

# Display what we're doing
echo "========================================"
echo "Creating Release Archive"
echo "========================================"
print_status "Creating release archive: ${RELEASE_NAME}"
print_status "Excluding: node_modules, .git"

# Create temporary exclude list file
EXCLUDE_FILE="/tmp/deploy_excludes_$$"
cat > "$EXCLUDE_FILE" << EOF
node_modules
.git
${DIR_NAME}_release_*.tar.gz
EOF

# Create the archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar --exclude-from="$EXCLUDE_FILE" -czf "${RELEASE_NAME}" . 2>/tmp/tar_warnings_$$

# Capture the tar command exit status
TAR_EXIT_CODE=$?

# Check if the archive was created successfully
if [ $TAR_EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ] || [ $TAR_EXIT_CODE -eq 1 ]; then
    # Tar exit code 1 means some files changed during archiving, which is acceptable
    if [ -f "${RELEASE_NAME}" ]; then
        print_status "Release archive created successfully!"
        print_status "File: $(pwd)/${RELEASE_NAME}"
        print_status "Size: $(du -h "${RELEASE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"
        
        # Show warnings if any (but not errors)
        if [ $TAR_EXIT_CODE -eq 1 ]; then
            print_warning "Some files changed during archiving (normal in active environments)"
        fi
        
        # Clean up temporary files
        rm -f "$EXCLUDE_FILE" /tmp/tar_warnings_$$
        
        echo
        echo "========================================"
        echo "Deployment Summary"
        echo "========================================"
        print_status "Release archive ready for deployment"
        if [ "$SEND_CONFIG" = true ]; then
            print_status "Configuration sent to deployment orchestrator"
        fi
        exit 0
    fi
fi

# If we get here, there was a real error
print_error "Failed to create release archive"
if [ -f /tmp/tar_warnings_$$ ]; then
    echo "Details:"
    cat /tmp/tar_warnings_$$
fi

# Clean up temporary files
rm -f "$EXCLUDE_FILE" /tmp/tar_warnings_$$
exit 1

    # Read each line from .env.test
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then

        fi

        # Skip if key is empty
        if [ -z "$key" ]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if variable is set and not empty
        if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Environment variable '$key' is not set or is empty"
            return 1
        fi
    done < ".env.test"
    
    echo "All environment variables validated successfully!"
    return 0

# Function to send config to deployment orchestrator
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    echo "Sending validated config to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping config submission."
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Convert .env.test to JSON format
    CONFIG_JSON="{"
    FIRST_ITEM=true
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then

        if [ -z "$key" ]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Add comma if not first item
        if [ "$FIRST_ITEM" = true ]; then
            FIRST_ITEM=false
        else
            CONFIG_JSON="${CONFIG_JSON},"
        fi
        
        # Add key-value pair to JSON (properly escaped)
        CONFIG_JSON="${CONFIG_JSON}\"${key}\":\"${value}\""

    else
        echo "ERROR: Failed to send config to deployment orchestrator (HTTP $RESPONSE)"
        if [ -f response.txt ]; then
            echo "Response: $(cat response.txt)"

        return 1
    fi

        # Skip if key is empty

            continue
        fi
        
        # Add comma if not the first entry
